text: Our earth is a beautiful planet. It has big forests, rivers, and lakes. Many animals live in the forest, and colorful flowers grow near the rivers. The sun gives light to plants, and rain gives them water. Without water and air, no living thing can grow. But today, our earth has a problem: pollution. Cars and factories make the air dirty. Rivers and lakes are not clean anymore. This is bad for animals and people. We must protect our earth. We can plant more trees near our homes. Trees make the air clean again. We can also recycle paper, plastic, and glass instead of throwing them away. When the wind blows, it can carry pollution far away, so clean air is important for everyone. Children in school learn to keep the sky and water clean. If we protect nature now, our earth will grow healthier every year. Every person can help: plant a tree, recycle your rubbish, and keep water clean. Small actions help our beautiful earth.
